show.title: Behind the Margins
description: How do businesses really make money—and what’s left after the bills are paid?

Behind the Margins is a student-led podcast exploring business models through conversations with founders, CEOs and business leaders. We unpack revenue, costs, pricing and profit margins to understand what makes a business work.
From familiar brands to unexpected ventures, discover the decisions, challenges and trade-offs behind the numbers.
For students, aspiring entrepreneurs and anyone curious about business.

episodes.title: Behind the Margins of a French restaurent in KL - Episode 1
summary: In our first episode, we sit down with Firmin Rieu, a French chef and entrepreneur running a French restaurant in Malaysia, to follow the money through a business most of us only see from the dining table.

We explore how his costs and profit margins compare with industry benchmarks, how he manages staff turnover, and how his customer base shapes revenue. Discover what it takes to turn a passion for food into a profitable business.

episodes.title: Behind the Margins of Secret Recipe - Episode 2
summary: Does operating a large restaurant chain mean bigger profit margins?
In this episode, we sit down with Secret Recipe’s CEO, Patrick Sim Chee Hong, to explore the revenue, costs and profits behind both the chain and its individual restaurants.

We discuss dine-in and delivery sales, the role of in-house production, and the decisions involved in running a restaurant business at scale. Discover how a familiar brand turns meals and cakes into a business and what shapes the margins along the way.

episodes.title: Behind the Margins of Olympic academy - A micro learning company
summary: In episode four we talk to Josiah Ng, Olympic cyclist and founder of Olympic academy. Olympic academy is a very new micro learning company which incorporates olympics athletes story's of hard work and challenges into effective life lessons.
We learn about what drove him to create this company, why he thinks it can be effective. What his different possible sources of revenue will be and the details of being in the piloting phase.
